messages:
Maya: quick ask 1: can we collate pilot feedback into one digest for product tomorrow? focus: onboarding blockers, feature asks, any explicit renewal risk comments
Ravi: yep. i'll mine call notes from three pilot accounts and drop a short CSV. want columns: customer, problem, severity(low/med/high), renewal_risk(yes/no/unclear), quote, contact, call_ts
June: add a column for "triage action" (docs/engineering/ops) + estimated time-to-fix (days/weeks). keeps handoff clean.
Maya: nailed it. keep rows concise, one sentence each. product wants scannable priorities. ops-bot: FYI weekly product sync scheduled 10am PT tomorrow 1.
Ravi: raw snippets pasted below from recordings, will normalize:
- Nimbus: onboarding wizard stuck on "creating workspace" for >90s, rep couldn't finish demo, "lost buyer confidence" -> high severity, renewal mentioned
- Coral: unclear token billing on routes, finance asked for export -> med severity, unclear renewal
- Atlas: SDK sample auth flow throws 401 intermittently during setup -> high severity, at-risk call noted
June: good. i'll mark Coral as docs-first (sample billing export + quickstart note).
Maya: Ravi, when you post CSV, also add "customer-visible impact" 1-5 so we can sort by renewal risk quickly.
Ravi: CSV uploaded to drive: <link> 1 1. included timestamps and recording links.
product: Received, will review before sync. Quick q: can you attach API error snippets for Atlas? engineering asked for logs to estimate.
Ravi: attaching log excerpt now: "ERROR 401 Authorization failed at sdk/auth.js:45" and endpoint `/v1/sdk/init`.
June: triage complete: flagged Atlas as "needs immediate triage" and Nimbus as "high priority but ops workaround available". Coral scheduled for docs update.
Maya: i'll compile digest and push to backlog as pre-read. action items: Ravi finalizes CSV with impact scores, June drafts docs update plan, Maya pings product for initial estimates.
product: Thanks 1. we'll aim to estimate level-of-effort in tomorrow's sync and tag any items that affect Q2 renewals.
ops-bot: Backlog updated with 4 new items from this thread.
